subtitle: Lesson 15 · Calendars and Currencies

code:
Accounting Calendar defines:
  Period Type (Month, 13-period, Week, Quarter...)
  Number of periods per fiscal year
  Start and end dates for each period
  Period names and numbering convention
  Fiscal year start month (not always January)
caption: Every journal, invoice, and balance ties to one of these periods.
